Priya (PM): Proposal: a 'fast-fail beta runway' for design partners. 1-week scoped runs, focused hypothesis, strict abort rules. Want to lock recruitment criteria + success metric by Wed. Thoughts?
Ben (Eng): +1. Keep scope tiny: prompt variants, config flags, or eval harness only. No routing or model swaps without infra sign-off.
Carla (GTM): Good for sales cadence. Target list: 1) customers with latency owners, 2) AEs with clear KPIs. Need a short outreach blurb.
Mateo (Design): Partners must commit to a 30m demo at end and one quick evaluator. I can prepare a 1-page prompt pack.
Anya (Solutions): Incentives: $1k credit + co-marketing mention if results are public-friendly. Also provide a short rollout playbook.
Jordan (Infra): Ops constraints: require 48h notice for canary windows. Any infra-level change triggers a 72h lead and SRE approval.
Priya (PM): Draft intake rubric (0-4 each): product fit, eval readiness, commitment; plus a 0-2 risk axis. Threshold = 8/12.
Ben (Eng): Add binary field: "requires infra change". If true -> auto-escalate and block until SRE sign-off.
DevRelBot: Auto-survey template created: https://forms.gle/fast-fail-feedback (results -> #dp-feedback). Reminder 2 days after demo.
Priya (PM): Proposed success rules: either measurable improvement (latency down >=10% or cost down >=15%) without >5% regression in error rate OR a documented clear product decision (ship/iterate/stop) + partner satisfaction >=4/5.
Carla (GTM): I'll draft outreach + pipeline tag and share by EOD.
Mateo (Design): I'll deliver the prompt pack and a short evaluation rubric.
Jordan (Infra): I'll publish canary windows and the infra checklist. Need partner list by Friday 12pm PT.
Ben (Eng): I'll write the safe-scope list and an engineering time estimate per scope.
Priya (PM): If no blockers, I'll lock criteria Wed 10am PT and start outreach. Drop any major issues here before EOD. :eyes:
